title: Admin shell string extraction
summary: Admin shell chrome, Access screens, Plugins, Maintenance, flashes, and permission display labels now come from UK English lang files. Stored permission keys and URLs are unchanged.
changes: Move Admin nav, Overview, Users, Access, Plugins, and Maintenance copy into lang/en_GB/admin.php.
Move Admin controller flash messages into admin.flash.* keys.
Resolve permission display titles via admin.permissions.labels.* while leaving stored permission names untouched.
Keep Super Admin out of Admin shell nav wording; regenerate the hard-coded string inventory (Admin section 0).
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: Admin shell extraction after auth/mail extract (0.38.4).
validation: php artisan lang:inventory — Admin section count 0.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Public chrome and APES CIC staff hub strings remain hard-coded until subsequent Wave 2 patches (#268, #269).
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Admin UI returns to prior hard-coded English if lang keys are removed; no database migrations are included.
